head: cf18bf59a
sourceState: Task52 production implementation was already in HEAD from the integrated core snapshot. This verification found and fixed one Task52-owned Apply orchestration defect plus two committed-test defects.

ownedChanges.reason: Apply restart passed the registry entry input, including displayPath, into the admission callback. The service admission builds a strict WorkerBootstrapSchema and rejected the extra key with a ZodError, which restartIdleSessions reported as SESSION_RESTORE_FAILED. The restart now strips displayPath for admission and keeps it for openResolved/reference persistence, mirroring the create and reopen routes. Adds one line plus a comment.
Regression assertion in the explicit-idle-restart test: the admission input must not contain displayPath.

Committed test could not isolate native directories: Bun caches os.homedir(), so per-test HOME assignments still resolved /home/shizuku/.omp and collided with a pre-existing local-proof marketplace. The suite now re-executes once in a child with an isolated HOME, strips inherited native profile/XDG variables, clears native plugin/marketplace state per fixture, and asserts the owner root against the process home.
Committed admission test called CatalogAdmission with the old two-argument shape and timed out. It now passes (input, reconcile, launch) for captured and ordinary admissions.

applyRootCause.symptom: POST /plugins/apply returned 200 persistence committed but result status failed and worker outcome SESSION_RESTORE_FAILED with the prior generation retained.
applyRootCause.cause: SessionRegistry.restartIdleSessions built the admission input from entry.input, which includes displayPath. Service admission parses that input as a strict WorkerBootstrapSchema; the extra displayPath produced ZodError unrecognized_keys. restartIdleSessions caught the error and mapped it to SESSION_RESTORE_FAILED. The create and reopen routes already destructure displayPath away before admission, so only the Apply restart path regressed.
applyRootCause.evidence: Bounded in-process reproduction of the real AgentService with real worker processes and runtime method tracing printed: [diag] admit threw ZodError: [{ code: unrecognized_keys, keys: [displayPath] }]. Host service stderr is discarded by agent-service-supervisor.js, so the original Web Host smoke could not surface it.
applyRootCause.fix: packages/agent-service/src/sessions/registry.ts now destructures displayPath out of the restart admission input while still passing it to openResolved for reference persistence.

postFixApplyProof.method: Bounded reproduction outside the repo: real AgentService (src supervisor and worker entrypoints), isolated HOME, registered workspace, real native session, valid authored local extension that appends a marker when evaluated, and the production POST /api/agent/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/plugins/apply route with expectedRevision 0 and strategy restart-idle-sessions.
postFixApplyProof.meaning: The restarted generation loaded the authored extension again while the same native session file remained byte-identical.

servicePacket.result: 22 pass, 7 skip, 0 fail, 161 expect() calls, 69.72 s
servicePacket.detail: The 7 skips are the worker plugin fixtures in the parent process; the file re-executes those 7 in a fresh-HOME child and fails if that child does not exit 0. Supervisor 3/3 after the signature fix; session plugins 3/3; registry-native 14/14 including the new displayPath regression.

hostPacket.failures: The three canonical-host-routes failures are the pre-existing Task54 usage-range tests (GET /api/agent/v1/usage and /usage/tools return 400), unrelated to Task52 plugin routes; the plugin Host file is 5/5 alone.

ui.result: PluginStatusBanner 3 pass/12 expect; PluginsPage 3 pass/19 expect (direct bun test; the package test script expects a directory root)

staticChecks.agentServiceTypeCheck: bun run type-check in packages/agent-service after the Apply fix: exit 0
staticChecks.changedFilesLint: bunx oxlint on registry.ts and the three test files reports only the pre-existing registry.ts anti-slop findings (unchanged lines 263-694); no finding on the changed restart block or tests

fixBeforeAfter.workerCatalogBefore: file alone: 6 pass, 2 fail (Marketplace "local-proof" already exists; owner root /home/shizuku/.omp/plugins instead of the fixture root)
fixBeforeAfter.supervisorBefore: file alone: 2 pass, 1 fail; captured admission test timed out at 60 s
fixBeforeAfter.after: both files pass as recorded above

webSmoke.method: Real packages/web Host (server/index.js --api-only) with its supervised Agent Service, isolated HOME and OPENCHAMBER_DATA_DIR, password session, a local loopback OpenAI-compatible provider defined only in the isolated native models.yml, and a settings.json project. No external registry, package, or marketplace request was made.
webSmoke.applyAfterFix: Verified through the production AgentService apply route and real worker processes (postFixApplyProof); the full Web Host was not rerun after the one-line fix because the Host adds only authentication, workspace scope and proxying around the same route, and those were exercised by the pre-fix Host run and the Host packet.

securityReview.boundary: Host canonical routes / plugin contract / worker native managers
findings: no blocking finding: every /plugins route resolves the authorized workspace scope before proxying; pluginName/extensionId route params must equal the parsed body identity.

no blocking finding: enterprise mode gates install, uninstall, update, and marketplace refresh with 403 enterprise_mode; local authoring, enable/disable, doctor and catalog reads remain local and available.

no blocking finding: PluginLocalSource confines to realpath(workspace)/.omp/extensions, validates flat .ts/.js/.mts/.mjs names, rejects traversal, rejects symlinked directories and files (O_NOFOLLOW read, lstat write/delete, realpath recheck before atomic rename), caps source at 1 MiB, and uses Bun.Transpiler.transform (parse only, no evaluation or import) before commit.
no blocking finding: Node Host and UI contain no @oh-my-pi imports; extension modules execute only in the Bun service worker.
nonblocking: public plugin settings omit declared secret values and expose only configured/globalConfigured/overridden flags.

notes: Apply restart now matches create/reopen admission hygiene: displayPath stays a registry/reference field and never reaches the strict worker bootstrap.
The two committed test defects were test-only; no other production behavior changed.
The worker fixture wrapper keeps the exact task packet command working while preventing ambient ~/.omp writes.
The Host packet's three usage-range failures predate Task52 and belong to Task54; the plugin Host file passes alone.

environmentCleanup: Normal and enterprise Hosts exited 0; no listener remains on 45201/45202; isolated HOME/data/workspace, local provider, repro scripts and smoke results were removed. No temporary diagnostic source remains.
limitations: Web UI bundle was not served (API-only Host); plugin UI rendering is covered by PluginStatusBanner/PluginsPage component tests.

The full Web Host Apply path was not rerun after the one-line fix; the identical production AgentService apply route was proven with real workers, new generation, unchanged transcript and a twice-evaluated local extension.
No external package or marketplace installation, update, or refresh was attempted in either mode; enterprise refusal is proven before any egress.
Packaged Electron and mobile behavior were not exercised.
